author_or_account: Yale Tobin Center for Economic Policy
title: New study on evictions and children's welfare
discussion_signal: The post circulates a study of eviction's causal effects on children's welfare and frames housing displacement as a pathway into educational and developmental disruption. It connects a formal housing event to child outcomes rather than treating eviction as only a residential move.
linked_research_question: How does eviction convert housing instability into residential, school, and developmental disruption for children?
limits: The post is a research announcement and does not provide full estimates
Study context may not generalize to all eviction settings
A causal estimate for studied outcomes does not establish effects on every dimension of child welfare
